name: Supervisor Dashboard — Approve counted task to manager review
description: Supervisor logs in with test_supervisor, views submitted item TS-ITEM-001, and approves it to forward to manager review.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter test_supervisor into the username field and Test@123456 into the password field
Locate the item TS-ITEM-001 in the supervisor cartable and select its checkbox or click approve
Click the confirmation button to confirm approval and send to manager
Verify that the item TS-ITEM-001 is approved and forwarded to manager review
